meaning.en: Horizon is the apparent meeting of earth or sea and sky; standard translation 地平线. 火 means fire, not horizon. Direct lexical equivalence: No.

rationale.en: Greek delimitation motivates the separate 划 huà candidate. Fire imagery is secondary visual/literary Research, not historical evidence.

semantic_relation: Indirect / cultural / visual, not lexical equivalence

summary.en: Greek horos (boundary) → horizein (to limit) → horizōn (kuklos), a limiting circle → Latin horizōn → Old French → Middle English orizon → English horizon (American Heritage). The Académie independently records French orizonte in the thirteenth century and borrowing through Latin from Greek. These are dictionary histories, not reconstructed recordings.
summary.zh-Hans: 据 American Heritage：希腊语 horos（边界）→ horizein（界定）→ horizōn (kuklos)（界定的圆周）→ 拉丁语 horizōn → 古法语 → 中古英语 orizon → 英语 horizon。法兰西学院辞典独立记载法语十三世纪 orizonte 及经拉丁语借自希腊语的路径。此处是辞书词史，不是历史录音或古音拟构。

claim.en: Greek horos (boundary) → horizein (to limit) → horizōn (kuklos), a limiting circle → Latin horizōn → Old French → Middle English orizon → English horizon (American Heritage). claim.en: Weak surface resemblance in both Cambridge UK and US /həˈraɪ.zən/. The author-selected hor-/hori- spans /həɹ-/ or /həˈɹaɪ-/; it is not a /hɔː/ syllable. Mandarin huǒ is descriptively [xwɔ˨˩˦]. Shared voiceless friction is limited support: onset place, vowels, glide, rhotic and tone differ. Qualitative assessment, not a measured similarity score.

claim.en: Horizon is the apparent meeting of earth or sea and sky; standard translation 地平线. 火 means fire, not horizon. Direct lexical equivalence: No.

summary.en: Author-proposed HORIZON → SUNRISE / SUNSET / LIGHT → FIRE/SUN imagery → 火. The sun also appears above the horizon; horizon does not mean fire. A visual/cultural association, not a lexical definition or solar-physics claim.

supporting_cases: One author-proposed visual pair; no independent mapping replication
counterexamples: horizon ≠ fire：地平线与火没有直接词义等同。
Greek historical etymology independent：希腊语边界词史独立于火及拉丁语 horrēre。
hor + zone false segmentation risk：表面拆分不能冒充历史词素；horizon 甚至不含完整的 zone 字符串。
Sunrise imagery is cultural/visual association：太阳也在地平线上方；地平线并不必有太阳或火。
Sound resemblance may be chance：选取片段、按拼写联想与挑选案例会造成偏差。
ABHOR/HORIZON 历史词族分离；不能从两个作者映射推出 English hor- = 火。

testability.en: Pre-register UK/US recordings and Mandarin tokens; compare matched random pairs, horizon→地平线 semantic controls, sound-only versus image-prompted listeners, and ABHOR as a distinct-family control. Measure phonetic ratings and memory benefit separately. Deduplicate real etymological families; no single-case generalization.
testability.zh-Hans: 预注册英美录音与普通话材料；比较匹配随机词对、horizon→地平线语义对照、仅听声音与图片提示条件，另以 ABHOR 作不同词族对照。音近评分与记忆收益分别检验；真实词源家族去重，不从单例归纳规律。

text.en: Winter colours are in fashion. A few simple colours feel bright, light and quietly beautiful. Looking far away on the first day of spring, I imagine flowers emerging and waiting to bloom. The distance to the horizon is not so far after all.
text.zh-Hans:
冬天的颜色，正是现在的流行色。简单的几种颜色搭配在一起，显得明亮、轻快、靓丽而静洁。

目光投向极远处。花朵正在悄悄顶出泥土。立春日，沿着地平线走一趟，看看远方的地平线。那里已经有鲜花等待盛开。

到地平线的距离，其实并不远。

gloss.zh-Hans: 地平线（标准翻译）；火是独立候选

meaning.en: Horizon is the apparent meeting of earth or sea and sky; standard translation 地平线. 火 means fire, not horizon. Direct lexical equivalence: No.
meaning.zh-Hans: horizon 指视野中天地或海天看似相接的界线；标准翻译是地平线。火的基本义是燃烧的火，不是地平线。直接词义等同：No。

rationale.en: Author-proposed HORIZON → SUNRISE / SUNSET / LIGHT → FIRE/SUN imagery → 火. The sun also appears above the horizon; horizon does not mean fire. A visual/cultural association, not a lexical definition or solar-physics claim.

summary.en: Greek horos (boundary) → horizein (to limit) → horizōn (kuklos), a limiting circle → Latin horizōn → Old French → Middle English orizon → English horizon (American Heritage). The Académie independently records French orizonte in the thirteenth century and borrowing through Latin from Greek. These are dictionary histories, not reconstructed recordings.

boundary.en: Horizon is the apparent meeting of earth or sea and sky; standard translation 地平线. 火 means fire, not horizon. Direct lexical equivalence: No.

claim.en: ABHOR: Latin abhorrēre, ab- + horrēre (bristle/shudder) → recoil/aversion. HORIZON: Greek horos/horizein → boundary/limiting circle. Distinct historical families; mapping both to 火 does not imply English hor- = 火. Surface sound cluster may support a hypothesis but does not establish shared etymology.
claim.zh-Hans: ABHOR：拉丁语 abhorrēre，ab- + horrēre（毛发竖起／战栗）→ 退缩／厌恶。HORIZON：希腊语 horos／horizein → 边界／界定圆周。两条历史词族分离；都映射到火，也不能推出 English hor- = 火。表面声音聚类可以支持提出假说，却不能确立共同词源。
